one_line: A descriptive literature review of ISO 50001 energy management system implementation, benefits, and challenges, compiling CEM award case studies across many sectors (including steel, petrochemicals, fertilizers/ammonia, pulp & paper, and power generation) without itself applying or validating anything in a continuous-flow production context.
